question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She found herself in an ______ situation and left quickly.
solution:
The correct answer is "**awkward**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Awkward** means **weird and strange**.

 
 
• **Example:** *This vegetable looks **awkward.** *
 
 
 
• The woman has **left quickly** as mentioned in the sentence. Hence, the situation</stron
